body:
Restart plan, revision 3 (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-27 ~01:16Z).
Status: POSTPONED. At 00:53Z Greg was sent "restart now" for master 69a02f72, after Legal R-LIB8 ended and Central was quiet. He answered via Asistant #2903: „Nie mogę przez najbliższe kilka godzin.” The Central hold is lifted and all held work resumed.
Not yet installed on the running Central build:
- 22781ce1: w-3346 detach scan.
- 641b9bc1: w-e12f.
- 11d1d110: w-32ed, definite relay writer-admission refusal instead of UNKNOWN.
- 69a02f72: w-a46f, one-line delivery row.
- Later landings will add to this.
Next attempt: when Greg says he is available.
- Opus2 gives a fresh quiet check: no cargo, FULL, evaluator or reviewer child running on Central, including other projects' runs that are background children of TermAl sessions (for example Legal's).
- Mail Engram::Fable 15 minutes before "restart now".
- Hold spawns and landings from "restart now" until Greg says it's done.
- Named roots are lost on restart (w-8f74); owners re-name them afterwards.
- Engram's bd4b is a CLI change and needs no TermAl restart.

Update (01:39Z): master is now f8560ab1f6d2607f596997e4a413ff8dde987969, which adds w-2f9d (listener preface deadline on the control clock, landed from WinB). The restart content is master f8560ab1 plus any later landings.

Update (02:27Z): master is now 995515bc5c74f853b37790e01c48d27ba05ca2df, which adds w-5c63 (test-only: src/tests/queue_pause_reason.rs). That landing changes no runtime code, so it alone gives no reason to restart.

PROCEDURE FIX (03:35Z), per rules-waits-and-wakes-greg-act-holds-2026-11-12. At 00:53Z I sent "restart now" WITHOUT first getting Greg's readiness reply, and Opus2 held spawns for about 23 min until he declined. Next attempt, in order:
1. Ask Greg via Asistant (and Advisor) whether he is ready, and wait for his „zaczynam” / readiness reply.
2. Only then hold Central spawns and landings, and set the one-time deadline check (agreed start plus 15 min). If the host-lifecycle record shows no new instance by then, lift the hold and tell every lane.

C3 OF w-bebbae70639c RIDES ON THE NEXT RESTART (04:00Z). Its evaluation 80578a77 failed C3 because no operator act has yet fully followed the procedure. The next restart must, and the record goes on w-bebb:
(a) Greg's readiness reply („zaczynam”) via Asistant BEFORE any hold;
(b) the restart instruction sent as an ACTIONABLE instruction (not a "do not relay" copy) on BOTH Engram::Asistant (588693a8) AND Engram::Advisor (b9d13887-b07c-4981-8af2-6f9ec8e5b33c);
(c) a one-time check at the agreed start plus 15 min (CronCreate one-shot), reading the host-lifecycle record, with its outcome recorded.
Then request a fresh w-bebb evaluation.

UPDATE 2026-11-27 ~08:23Z (Fable2, Opus2 #8233/#8234): the next restart NO LONGER waits for w-e638 (R13 found 2 new Mediums, the 4th straight round in the same area; a scope check was ordered). Content: master after eca7 lands (eca7 is in evaluation, RESERVE-LAND to 09:34Z), plus w-bb98 and/or e638 if they have landed by then, plus the already-landed 7e7c (61072da8, the ~340 ms summary_snapshot lock fix). Trigger: Opus2 reports that eca7 has landed. Then Fable2 asks Greg for readiness FIRST, and the full procedure follows. The batched -j1 install runs in a gap between Legal builds. If e638 lands later, it gets the following restart (Engram bd4b waits for it).

UPDATE 2026-11-27 13:24Z: eca7 (009173ad, 09:52Z), bb98 (86f6314c, 12:01Z) and e638 R19 (233e9bbe, 13:22Z) have ALL landed. Restart content is master 233e9bbed272c59881523f793ac1b2dc731ba91e, and one restart covers everything (Engram bd4b unblocks after it). Greg's readiness was requested at ~09:55Z (Asistant #2947, Advisor #3023); there's no reply yet, and nothing is held. Legal's history slot 1 is complete, so the restart can fall at any time. The w-bebb record (step a) is noted. Install is batched with the restart; Greg's start rebuilds anyway.

GATE ADDED 2026-11-27 14:05Z: the WinB Windows FULL of ee06 G9 failed on a test added by e638 R19 (receipt_confirmation_refuses_fresh_and_reused_attempt_installation; reused=false, expected true), P0 w-1f9dcc25d476, owned by Sol-a7bb. Central is WINDOWS, so the restart would run e638's code on Windows. Before "restart now", w-1f9d must be classified TEST-ONLY (the restart proceeds) or PRODUCT (Fable2 decides from a one-line impact statement). Opus2 #8257.

ATTEMPT 2026-11-27 (Fable2): Greg said he was ready at 17:10Z („2. Tak, moge zrobić teraz”). Hold started 17:11Z, Engram got its 15-minute notice, and the instruction for 17:27Z went on Asistant #2959 and Advisor #3024. The deadline wake at 17:42Z found NO restart: instance 38361b52 unchanged, termal.exe sha e5f0375c unchanged, no „zaczynam”. The hold was lifted and Opus2, Engram and Greg were told. The procedure was followed fully and recorded on w-bebb. The restart is STILL PENDING on master 8fcc0fbd or later. Next attempt: from Greg's new readiness, with Engram's 15-minute notice again.
